degradation_components.MapUnavailableBanner: New shared/map component. role='alert' aria-live='polite' overlay (position:absolute, z-index 1100 above Leaflet panes), warning-token background, i18n 'map.unavailable' = 'Mapa dočasně nedostupná' / 'Map temporarily unavailable'. Text carries the message; no decorative-only content.
degradation_components.MapyMap_degraded_branch: Replaced the WI-15 loading-placeholder-on-error with real degradation (rules/web-realtime.md#last-known-state). Two failure modes: (1) /geo/config errored AND no config -> still mount MapContainer (NO TileLayer => grey background) using caller center or the Prague FALLBACK_CENTER [50.0755,14.4378]/zoom 12, render children (markers place by their own coords) + MapUnavailableBanner. (2) config present but TileLayer fires eventHandlers.tileerror -> tilesFailed state drops the tile layer and shows the banner (logo link hidden while degraded). Loading state (no config, no error, no caller viewport) unchanged.
degradation_components.no_coords_indicator: New pure module features/board/orderCoords.ts `orderHasNoCoords(order: PickupCoords)` — true when pickup lat/lng explicitly null OR the (0,0) sentinel; FALSE when both undefined (a projection that omits coords entirely — flagging undefined would false-positive every row). Generalized to a structural PickupCoords shape so it accepts BOTH OrderSummaryDto (board card) and OrderDetailDto (drawer). Wired into TWO surfaces: OrderCard (board) and OrderDrawer read view — each renders a ⚠ (aria-hidden) + i18n 'map.noCoords' = 'bez souřadnic' / 'no coordinates' warning span under the pickup address when true (AC#2).
degradation_components.api_lane_dependency_BLOCKS_board_surface: VERIFIED against api/src/Taxi.Api/Features/Orders/Shared/OrderSummaryDto.cs: the backend order-list summary DTO has NO PickupLat/PickupLng fields at all (record ends at HasFailedSms). So on REAL board data those fields are absent -> undefined -> orderHasNoCoords returns false -> the OrderCard board indicator NEVER fires in production. The OrderCard.test passes only because it constructs an artificial pickupLat:null shape. The board wiring is correct and FORWARD-COMPATIBLE (activates the instant the backend adds `int? PickupLat`/`int? PickupLng`... actually double? lat/lng ... to the ListOrders projection + OrderSummaryDto), but it is INERT today. CONCRETE api-lane dependency to make the at-a-glance board indicator live: add PickupLat?/PickupLng? to OrderSummaryDto (api/.../Features/Orders/Shared/OrderSummaryDto.cs) and populate them in the ListOrders projection (api/.../Features/Orders/ListOrders/ListOrdersEndpoint.cs). NOT fixable in the web lane. The DRAWER surface (OrderDetailDto, which DOES carry pickupLat/pickupLng) makes AC#2 clause 1 functional in-lane today, so AC#2 is not fully blocked — only its board at-a-glance variant is.
degradation_components.reverse_degraded_coords_note: AC#2's 'reverse-geocode degraded shows coordinates instead of an address' — VERIFIED there is NO reverse-geocode-to-address consumer anywhere in web/src (grep rgeocode|reverse|getGeoReverse|reverseGeocode + read of PickupMapInner.tsx and AddressAutocomplete.tsx). PickupMapInner's pin-drag handler reports RAW coordinates directly via onPinMove(lat,lng) and the GPS path is an explicit 'client pin stub (no reverse-geocode endpoint)' per the AddressAutocomplete comment. So the degraded 'show coordinates instead of an address' state IS the current shipped behavior — done by existing behavior, NOT a punt. Deliberately did NOT build a new getGeoReverse-on-drag flow: WI-16 chose not to add that consumer, no WI-17 test_case pins it, and it is net-new feature scope beyond a degradation-UI WI.
